title: Shinnecock Nation Cultural Center and Museum
summary: The Shinnecock Nation Cultural Center and Museum is a Shinnecock-owned and operated museum dedicated to Shinnecock and Eastern Woodland history, culture, art, and living community memory. The museum preserves and interprets materials connected to Shinnecock life while challenging older museum habits that treated Native people as figures of the past.

why_this_matters: As the only Native American-owned and operated museum on Long Island, this cultural center actively reclaims the power to interpret Shinnecock history from an Indigenous perspective. By welcoming thousands of annual visitors to learn directly from Shinnecock community members and descendants, the institution dismantles outdated stereotypes and ensures that Native voices shape the public understanding of their own living heritage.
